contentBlocks.headline: Holistic solutions for the entrance area
contentBlocks.intro: From door communication and access control to architectural design – everything from a single source.

communication.label: Door Communication
communication.headline: Smart communication for every building
communication.text: From single-family homes to large residential quarters, TCS offers tailor-made audio and video door intercom systems such as the Senso Pro and TASTA PRO series. With the future-proof IP system snipdoo®, we combine the simplicity of classic BUS systems with unlimited network flexibility.

access.label: Access Control
access.headline: Access and management, rethought
access.text: The web-based BCM system is your central solution for modern building management – secure, scalable and holistic. Manage access rights for doors, barriers and parking areas flexibly via smartphone app, biometric scanner or RFID.

entry.label: Entry System
entry.headline: True individuality at the entrance
entry.text: The Entry design and mounting system ends the restless succession of different brands and bundles door communication, access control, mailboxes and fire protection in a homogeneous design – completely without visible screws.

signage.label: Signage
signage.headline: Clear orientation with aesthetic appeal
signage.text: Create representative entrance areas and intuitive wayfinding with TCS signage. Discover our smart, ultra-flat house numbers with revolutionary day-night contrast and durable LED backlighting.

solutions.label: Project Solutions
solutions.headline: Tailored equipment for special requirements
solutions.text: Every building has its own rules. We offer barrier-free solutions in line with DIN 18040-1 for care facilities, emergency call systems for schools, as well as efficient access control for clinics and public authorities.

consulting.label: Project Consulting
consulting.headline: From the first idea to the final implementation
consulting.text: Our experts support architects, planning offices and developers across all trades throughout the entire process. We assist you with system and material selection and ensure smooth implementation.

hero.headline: More than a manufacturer.
hero.intro: TCS is a family-run company and a comprehensive system provider for building communication, access control and integrated entrance solutions – with in-house development, manufacturing and service.

history.headline: A family business with an inventive spirit
history.p1: We Open Worlds. Under this motto, the family-run TCS AG has been developing and manufacturing system technology for building communication since 1995 – from simple door intercoms to complex large-scale systems for several hundred residential units.
history.p2: Founder Otto Duffner invented the world's first polarity-free, software-controlled 2-wire BUS intercom – the TCS:BUS®. This pioneering invention laid the foundation for rapid corporate development.
history.p3: Otto Duffner runs the company together with his youngest son Johannes Duffner on the executive board and his eldest son Florian Duffner on the supervisory board. Decades of experience and contemporary ideas in perfect balance.

system.title: System expertise
system.text: Not just individual products, but well thought-out systems for the entire building entrance – from the simple intercom to the complex large-scale system.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.text: In-house development, manufacturing and software – TCS invented the world's first software-controlled intercom based on the TCS:BUS in 1995.

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: Made in Germany. Manufacturing certified to DIN-ISO 9001 on more than 2,000 m² in Genthin and at the CARUS Manufaktur in Triberg. 5-year warranty on all products.

partnership.title: Partnership
partnership.text: Architecture, planning, installation and wholesale as a true partnership – with 18 field service teams and 6 training centres throughout Germany.

handel.title: German trade business
handel.text: Core range for door and building communication, video surveillance and electronic access control – via electrical wholesalers to the electrical trade.

international.title: International projects
international.text: System solutions for home automation, call and announcement management, age-appropriate comfort and assistance systems as well as system networking, nationally and internationally.

odm.title: ODM | OEM
odm.text: Customer-specific development, individual design and contract manufacturing including branding, labelling & packaging for European market leaders.

customising.title: Customising & manufaktur
customising.text: Individual product configurations, tailor-made user interfaces and one-off production – at the CARUS Manufaktur in Triberg.

manufacturing.headline: Made in Germany
manufacturing.intro: With experience and the latest technology, TCS produces small, medium and large series on more than 2,000 m² – certified to DIN-ISO 9001.

iso.title: DIN-ISO 9001
iso.text: Certified quality management from incoming goods inspection through intermediate checks to delivery.

smd.title: SMD assembly
smd.text: State-of-the-art automated assembly line for electronic circuit boards since 2018, ESD-protected and fully ERP-integrated.

ihk.title: IHK Training Award
ihk.text: First-class training quality – repeatedly recognised at state and federal level in metal and electrical engineering.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.text: Commitment to energy efficiency, pollutant avoidance and recyclability of materials and packaging.
